blocks.text: Every plan starts with a free 7-day trial. No credit card needed to start.

blocks.html:
Frequently asked questions

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. You can try Acuity free for 7 days without entering a credit card.

How am I billed?

Plans are billed monthly. Paying annually saves you money.

Which businesses use Acuity?

Acuity is used by businesses in beauty, wellness, fitness, education, business services and the visual and performing arts, among others.

Where can I get help?

Visit the Help Center, browse the webinars and blog, or get in touch with our support team.
